verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer AI product delivers root-cause analysis, automated triage, code review, and answers to telemetry questions directly inside the product (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-17, sentry-docs-23, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-31), matching the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from data.
